text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain to hold first exhibition on human resources in the Middle East in November.
- Bahrain imported around seven million dinars worth of perfumes, cosmetics and other beauty products in the first half of 1997.
- Health services cost Bahrain 45 million dinars a year.
- Around 2,000 Indian nationals visited their embassy over Bahrain's three-month amnesty period to illegal workers.
- Bahrain and the other Gulf Arab states could learn from South Korea's trade promotions drive, a commerce ministry official says. AKHBAR ALKHALEEJ
- Aluminium Bahrain produces three percent of the world's aluminium output.
- Prime minister praises relations with the United States and its efforts to maintain security and stability of the Gulf region.
